einzeiler: Former Panthers stars discuss preseason realities, team growth and Luke Kuechly.
kurzfassung: Former Carolina Panthers players Jake Delhomme and Jonathan Stewart launch their new podcast by breaking down the team's preseason and joint practices. They analyze quarterback Bryce Young's development and expectations for the upcoming season. The hosts also reflect on attending Luke Kuechly's Hall of Fame induction and pay tribute to longtime team doctor Robert Heyer.
stichpunkte: Origin story of the podcast name, referencing classic gap scheme plays like power and buster
Evaluation of preseason dynamics, shifting from traditional four-game schedules to joint practices
Comparison of joint practices to family cookouts where teams show their true colors
Assessment of the Carolina Panthers' offensive line depth and upcoming competition against Jacksonville
Discussion on running back experiences and the persistent mental hurdle of returning from injuries
Analysis of quarterback Bryce Young entering a crucial year for consistency and leadership
Reflections on attending Canton for Luke Kuechly's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction ceremony
Tribute to the late Dr. Robert Heyer and his two-decade impact on the Carolina Panthers organization

kapitel.titel: Offensive Line Concerns and Roster Competition
Luke Kuechly's Hall of Fame Induction

clips.hook: Fullbacks are disappearing in modern football
clips.text: The disappearance of the fullback position in modern football has fundamentally changed how defensive fronts are attacked.

clips.hook: Preseason records mean nothing in the NFL
clips.text: Preseason records are poor indicators of postseason success, as evidenced by the Baltimore Ravens' failure to reach the Super Bowl despite undefeated exhibition runs.

clips.hook: Andy Reid runs the toughest training camp in the league
clips.text: Andy Reid’s physically demanding training camp practices have been a cornerstone of the Kansas City Chiefs' consistent success over the last eight years.

clips.hook: Bryce Young's pulse drops when the pressure rises
clips.text: Coach Canales is emphasizing personal accountability within the offense, noting how some players remain remarkably calm during high-pressure game situations.

clips.hook: Team doctors become family over decades of service
clips.text: The speaker reflects on the deep personal connections formed with team supporters like Pat Conner, Bob Anderson, and Dr. Robert Hyer during his time with the Panthers.

beschreibung: In the debut episode of *The Handoff*, Panthers legends Jake Delhomme and Jonathan Stewart break down the Panthers’ preseason, including the impact of joint practices, Bryce Young’s growth, the state of the offensive line and the team’s young core. In the debut episode of *The Handoff*, Panthers legends Jake Delhomme and Jonathan Stewart break down the Panthers’ preseason, including the impact of joint practices, Bryce Young’s growth, the state of the offensive line and the team’s young core. They also reflect on Luke Kuechly’s Hall of Fame induction and remember longtime Panthers team doctor Robert Heyer.
